parameters.name: SYSID_THISMAV
parameters.longDesc: MAVLink system ID this vehicle answers to. Fixed by the build.

parameters.name: MAV_SYS_ID
parameters.longDesc: Same value as SYSID_THISMAV, under the name a ground station looks for first.

parameters.name: SYS_COMP_ID
parameters.longDesc: MAVLink component ID of the bridge. Fixed by the build.

parameters.name: CAL_ACC0_ID
parameters.longDesc: Identifier of the calibrated IMU, taken from the flight controller. A ground station reads a non-zero value as "this sensor has been calibrated" and will otherwise refuse to arm or offer to calibrate. One IMU serves both axes, so this and CAL_GYRO0_ID report the same identifier.

parameters.name: CAL_GYRO0_ID
parameters.longDesc: Identifier of the calibrated IMU, taken from the flight controller. A ground station reads a non-zero value as "this sensor has been calibrated".

parameters.name: CAL_MAG0_ID
parameters.longDesc: Always zero: no magnetometer is fitted.

parameters.name: CAL_MAG1_ID
parameters.longDesc: Always zero: no magnetometer is fitted.

parameters.name: CAL_MAG2_ID
parameters.longDesc: Always zero: no magnetometer is fitted.

parameters.name: CAL_MAG0_ROT
parameters.longDesc: Always -1, the value for a magnetometer that is not fitted.

parameters.name: CAL_MAG1_ROT
parameters.longDesc: Always -1, the value for a magnetometer that is not fitted.

parameters.name: CAL_MAG2_ROT
parameters.longDesc: Always -1, the value for a magnetometer that is not fitted.

parameters.name: SENS_BOARD_ROT
parameters.longDesc: Always zero. The sensor orientation is a build-time setting on the flight controller, not something the ground station can change, so no rotation is reported here rather than one that could be edited and ignored.

parameters.name: SENS_DPRES_OFF
parameters.longDesc: Always zero. No airspeed sensor is fitted; the parameter exists because a ground station expects it to.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_MAG
parameters.longDesc: Always zero: no magnetometer is fitted.

parameters.name: SYS_HAS_NUM_ASPD
parameters.longDesc: Always zero: no airspeed sensor is fitted.

parameters.name: SYS_AUTOSTART
parameters.longDesc: Airframe identifier the ground station uses to pick its airframe page. Fixed by the build: the airframe is a property of the vehicle, not a setting.

parameters.name: COM_RC_IN_MODE
parameters.longDesc: Always zero: this vehicle is flown from an RC transmitter.

parameters.name: RC_CHAN_CNT
parameters.longDesc: Number of RC channels this firmware holds calibration for.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_ROLL
parameters.longDesc: RC channel carrying roll. Must be 1-4, and no two sticks may share a channel.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PITCH
parameters.longDesc: RC channel carrying pitch. Must be 1-4, and no two sticks may share a channel.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_YAW
parameters.longDesc: RC channel carrying yaw. Must be 1-4, and no two sticks may share a channel.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_THROTTLE
parameters.longDesc: RC channel carrying throttle. Must be 1-4, and no two sticks may share a channel.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_FLAPS
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. This airframe has no flaps.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_AUX1
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. Auxiliary channel mappings are not implemented.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_AUX2
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. Auxiliary channel mappings are not implemented.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PARAM1
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. In-flight parameter tuning is not implemented.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PARAM2
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. In-flight parameter tuning is not implemented.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PARAM3
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. In-flight parameter tuning is not implemented.

parameters.name: RC_MAP_PAY_SW
parameters.longDesc: Unmapped. No payload is carried.

parameters.name: MAV_HB_MS
parameters.longDesc: Interval between HEARTBEAT frames. Set at build time.

parameters.name: MAV_GPS_MS
parameters.longDesc: Interval between GPS_RAW_INT frames. Set at build time.

parameters.name: MAV_ATT_MS
parameters.longDesc: Interval between ATTITUDE frames. Set at build time.

parameters.name: MAV_GPOS_MS
parameters.longDesc: Interval between GLOBAL_POSITION_INT frames. Set at build time.

parameters.name: MAV_BATT_MS
parameters.longDesc: Interval between BATTERY_STATUS frames. Set at build time.

parameters.name: MAV_RC_MS
parameters.longDesc: Interval between RC_CHANNELS frames. Set at build time.

parameters.name: COM_RC_LOSS_T
parameters.longDesc: Reported as zero. The RC loss failsafe lives on the flight controller and is not configurable from here yet.

parameters.name: RC1_MIN

parameters.name: RC1_TRIM
parameters.longDesc: Pulse width with channel 1 centred, set by the radio calibration.

parameters.name: RC1_REV
parameters.longDesc: Whether channel 1 is reversed. Only +1 and -1 are accepted.
